_doc: RI-017 — truncated tool args (S-004). FunctionCall surfaces the invalid partial_json verbatim (the harness's downstream retry depends on seeing the raw bytes); the Completed envelope's stop_reason is OVERRIDDEN from 'tool_use' to 'max_tokens' so the model gets a retry signal. Assertion on stop_reason is in tests/pi_projection_equiv.rs (Stage C harness does not extract Completed from items).
